rationale: The plan correctly refuses to refit the count model, takes the supplied treated-vs-control DESeq2 table as the source, and audits its sign convention against per-group normalized counts, which is the right handling of a results-in-hand design. The ORA specification matches the reference on every point: universe restricted to non-NA-padj tested genes, GO Biological Process named with a human symbol source and version reported, hypergeometric test via clusterProfiler, BH at 0.05, 10-500 set size window with minimum overlap, redundancy collapse, and up/down lists tested separately alongside the pooled list with sizes reported. QC on library sizes and PCA with an explicit document-not-correct policy for sample_01 is present. Minor gaps: no mention of whether the supplied log2FC is shrunken before applying the |log2FC|>=1 cut, and the low-count filter and normalization criteria are only indirectly addressed (universe as independent-filtering survivors, VST for PCA) since no model is fit; software versions are only partly specified.
